richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bardhaman

c: Bardhaman, home to a large university, sits in the heart of West Bengal's rice country. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bardhaman to university and college campuses, schools, hostels, municipal parks and residential areas. Our Fun Fitness range is made at our factory in Vasai, about 1,610 km away, and delivered by road for installation by our team or a dealer in eastern India.

On a university campus, the best spot for an open gym is often between the hostels and the academic buildings, where students pass several times a day. Grouted installation suits campus use, because each post sits in concrete and handles hard daily wear. Bardhaman's summers are very hot, and the monsoon brings heavy rain, so plan for afternoon shade and good drainage. Students use these machines differently from older walkers, often in groups and with more force, so choose solid strength stations alongside a few gentler ones.

items.q: Can a university in Bardhaman order an open gym for students?
items.a: Yes. Share the location on campus and photos. We send a layout drawing with clear space around each station and a quote, then manufacture and install after approval.

items.q: Which machines take the heaviest use?
items.a: Strength stations with solid frames, such as the Cross Fit frame, Pull Up Station and double presses. Grouted installation keeps them firm under daily student use.
Three years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts, and 1 year on springs, bearings and spare parts, against manufacturing defects when installed and maintained as per our instructions.
